name: MobileEquipmentPrestartChecks
tagline: Digital pre-starts for mobile plant: checklists, go / no-go, tag-out and work requests in one Power Platform control.
description: Operators complete class-specific pre-start checklists with critical items; the app decides GO, GO WITH DEFECT or NO-GO, tags no-go machines out, hands defects to maintenance as work requests, tracks repair and supervisor release, and shows pre-start compliance per shift for the whole fleet. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Checklists per equipment class with critical items
Supervisor sign-off and return to service
One pre-start per unit and shift, SMU checks
Demo mode with fictional mine data
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
